name: Wooden Toy Boat
description: A small, intricately carved wooden boat resting on the windowsill. Its paint is faded but the craftsmanship is evident.

params.message: The toy boat is meticulously carved from a single piece of pine. Tiny sails are folded against its deck, and the hull bears traces of a long-dry varnish. It seems almost too fragile to sail.
You pick up the wooden toy boat. It is surprisingly light and smooth to the touch.
You place the boat on the surface of the bath water. It bobs gently, floating as if on a miniature sea. For a moment, the cold bathroom feels a little warmer.
